methodology.latency: Unmodified redis-benchmark CSV latency in milliseconds. Redis 8.2.1 records send-to-first-socket-read-event latency before parsing replies, reusing that sample for every reply in a pipeline. Only fields actually emitted by this binary are reported; these source-level semantics were established for Redis 8.2.1, not arbitrary client versions.

methodology.native_throughput_caveat: Redis 8.2.1 threaded completion detection uses a 250ms timer; short-pilot rps is quantized
methodology.random_keys: native-bench: plus 12 zero-padded digits; uniform native -r domain
methodology.redis: single-threaded default io-threads; no thread tuning
methodology.seed_limit: fixed seed does not promise identical interleaving across native client threads
methodology.writes: SET/HSET vary a fixed-width numeric payload suffix; ZADD varies the existing member score, rather than timing only same-value no-ops
